bic_trace_step.reason: In tw9906_probe(), after v4l2_ctrl_handler_init() and v4l2_ctrl_new_std() have allocated the handler and controls, the error path for a failed write_regs() call (lines 213-216) only frees dec via kfree(dec) but does not call v4l2_ctrl_handler_free(hdl).
